description: The bar chart illustrates the popularity scores of three large language models—Llama3 (blue), Qwen2 (red), and ChatGPT (yellow)—across three domains: Movies, Songs, and Basketball, with additional bars representing scenarios where model accuracy is zero but ground truth answers (Acc=0 & GT Ans) or generated answers (Acc=0 & Gene Ans) are present. The vertical axis, labeled “Popularity,” ranges from 0 to 220 in increments of 20, while the horizontal axis categorizes the domains. In the Movies domain, all three models show low popularity, with Llama3 around 30, Qwen2 around 40, and ChatGPT around 35; the “Acc=0 & GT Ans” bar is approximately 140, while “Acc=0 & Gene Ans” is not shown. In Songs, popularity increases: Llama3 reaches ~70, Qwen2 ~65, and ChatGPT ~75; “Acc=0 & GT Ans” is ~60, and “Acc=0 & Gene Ans” is ~50. In Basketball, popularity peaks: Llama3 ~150, Qwen2 ~190, ChatGPT ~170; “Acc=0 & GT Ans” is ~180, and “Acc=0 & Gene Ans” is ~140. The chart visually emphasizes that model popularity generally increases with domain specificity (from Movies to Basketball), and that ground truth answers in low-accuracy scenarios still maintain substantial popularity, particularly in Basketball. The bars are grouped by domain, with each model’s bar adjacent to others in the same group, and the “Acc=0” bars are patterned with cross-hatching for visual distinction.
